description: This class 'BitmapUtils' provides utility methods for loading images and descriptions, managing bitmap caching, and creating image thumbnails in an Android project. It includes data structures for storing photo resources and descriptions, and methods to load photos asynchronously and generate thumbnails.

classes.name: BitmapUtils
classes.description: Utility class for handling bitmap loading, caching, and thumbnail creation.

methods.name: loadPhotos
methods.description: Loads a list of PictureData objects with randomly selected photos and descriptions, creating thumbnails for display.

methods.name: getBitmap
methods.description: Retrieves a bitmap from cache or loads it from resources if not already cached.

methods.name: getThumbnail
methods.description: Creates a scaled thumbnail from a source bitmap, maintaining aspect ratio based on max dimension.
